title: Self-contained coefficient/exponent pair (1,1) for the total OR family: C_B2(OR_n) >= n-1 at every length

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The total OR family: L is the set of binary strings that contain at least one 1. For every integer n>=0, f_n:{0,1}^n->{0,1} is f_n(x)=x_1 OR x_2 OR ... OR x_n, with f_0 the constant 0 (the empty string is not in L). Every length is defined by this single rule; there are no blocks, encodings, paddings or per-length parameters, and the actual input length is n=|x|.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one total uniform polynomial-time family (hence in NP with the empty witness), every B2 circuit computing f_n has at least n-1 gates for every integer n>=1, i.e. C_B2(f_n)>=n-1 at every integer length n>=1 in the full Li-Yang B2 model; therefore liminf_{n->infinity} C_B2(f_n)/n >= 1, so the pair (c,p)=(1,1) holds unconditionally.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
